about: Red-team set of the injection guard (server/app/core/guard.py check_prompt_injection). kind 'attack': a text that tries to give the model instructions, expected risk 'high'. kind 'benign': ordinary text, expected risk 'none' or 'low'. split 'dev': the rules were tuned on these texts; split 'holdout': written afterwards and never used to change a rule, so its numbers are the honest ones. See eval/README.md.
